Bring up my pancake atom

Aug 17, 2026

Short version

I asked Claude to bring up my pancake atom. It found the cottage cheese protein pancake note and showed it as a recipe card: servings I could change, a timer on the rest.

The note is a short markdown file in Obsidian. I didn't open it. Claude did.

I was in Claude and typed bring up my pancake atom.

What's in the note

Half a cup of cottage cheese, two eggs, a third of a cup of flour, baking powder, salt, vanilla. Then: Blend. Rest 3 to 5 min. Cook at 350°F.

That's all of it. Tagged recipe and breakfast. I wrote it down so I'd remember the cottage cheese version. I didn't lay it out for a cooking app.

What Claude did with it

It didn't dump the markdown. It put the same note on their recipe card. I could change the servings. There was a timer on the rest.

That's Claude's card, not something I built. The note still lives in Obsidian. An agent can reach it, so I can ask the way I'd ask a person.

Most recipe notes I save, I never open again. I remember I have one. I don't remember the filename.
